parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster where the resource group is located.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance in the resource group. For more information, see [ListResourceInstances](~~412129~~). The instance name is the value of the HostName parameter in the response.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order.

- Asc: ascending order.

- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 100.

parameters.name: Ready
parameters.description: Indicates whether the health check passed.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the worker instance.

parameters.name: WorkerName
parameters.description: The name of the worker instance.
